title: psychotria cupularis
intro: Psychotria cupularis, commonly known as Cupularia or Yellow Cipangu, is a species of plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Psychotria cupularis include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria cupularis include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
